The native 7z writer uses a korTTY-modified sevenz-rust2 0.25.0 and
lzma-rust2 0.25.0. korTTY changes the AES credential and header handling
and the LZMA dependency features. See vendor/sevenz-rust2/KORTTY-PATCH.md.
Both crates are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The included
license text is identical to the LICENSE file in both crates.io archives.

https://github.com/hasenbanck/sevenz-rust2
https://github.com/hasenbanck/lzma-rust2
